name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.2 Standalone
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna release. v0.20.2 adds administrator cleanup tools for Needs ID and likely duplicate detection, preserves Jellyfin native multi-select for bulk Delete/Group Versions, and retains the consolidated Home, playback, Series/Season, subtitle, metadata-management, search and Live TV-ready behaviour.
